d: The role is responsible for designing, delivering and evaluating professional development initiatives for Sohar Aluminium employees across all levels and department, with a focus on graduate and internship programmes, professional assessments, individual development plans, behavioural and soft skills training, career development, professional accreditation.

The job holder serves as an internal trainer, facilitator, learning designer, assessor, coach and career counsellor, providing professional guidance to employees and management on competency development and career progression.

Development initiatives are delivered in line with the company's 70/20/10 learning philosophy through experiential, social and formal learning approaches through online Individual Development Plans (IDP’s) which are managed on the company’s online talent management system (SAP SuccessFactors).

The role also contributes to building the competencies and organisational culture required to support SA's strategic priorities, including culture workshops and change initiatives. It requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders, including line managers, HR functions, Business Improvement and EHS, as well as external training providers, professional bodies, academic institutions and relevant government entities.
r: 2.1 Manage SAC Graduate Development and Internship Programs

Collaborate with TOE colleagues and internal stakeholders to understand and implement allocation of bachelor graduate trainees for target positions across the plant as part of the company’s Annual Workforce Plan.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to agree internship trainee allocation across the plant and design any training to be included within their 2-month work experience program.
Contribute to the preparation of job and competency profiles as a basis for bachelors graduate trainee development based on the job description of the graduate’s target position.
Work with Recruitment team and external agencies to ensure the proper selection of fresh graduate trainee candidates as per the requirements.
Prepare individual development plans for all fresh graduates trainees, ensuring best practice approach in the format and methodology.
Actively monitor the progress of all bachelors graduate trainees during their development program to ensure coverage of all development areas.
Conduct mentoring and coaching sessions for graduates and interns.
Conduct periodic evaluation of the internship program and provide metrics to measure its effectiveness.
Collaborate with all stakeholders to ensure proper administration of employee development requirements for graduates and interns.
Facilitate fresh graduate integration with their assigned department and full transition into their target position after completion of their training program.
Develop and manage the standard company procedure for the selection, onboarding and progress of internship trainees, including feedback survey to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Support the SPOD to prepare and maintain a company standard procedure governing the company’s Graduate Development & Internship Programs, as per the SAC Integrated Management System
Facilitates professional assessment of employees (psychometric test, ability test, personality test, behavioral test, interviews, role playing, simulations, etc.)
Prepare individual development plans for newly hired or promoted employees based on competency gap analysis, ensuring they reach the required competence level within the agreed period.
Design and implement professional development initiatives, including mentoring/coaching programs as well as e-learning programs.
Collaborate with all stakeholders to ensure proper administration of employee training and other development-related requirements.
Develop and track metrics to measure training effectiveness following all 4 levels of the Kirkpatrick model.
Work with P&OD Superintendent to design and implement various leadership development programs for employees at different leadership levels
2.3 Act as Internal Trainer and Facilitator for soft skills, behavioural and leadership programs
Work with TOE colleagues to conduct a Training Needs Analysis to identify training requirements across all departments and incorporate within the company’s Training & Development Plan as required.
Programs will include but not limited to:
Deliver an agreed minimum number of training days per year (target set annually with the Superintendent).
Design training materials, facilitator guides and participant workbooks using adult learning principles; deliver in English and, where needed, Arabic.
Facilitate company culture workshops, leadership development programs and assessment/development centres.
Run Train-the-Trainer (TTT) sessions to build a pool of internal trainers and subject matter experts, and coach them on delivery.
Evaluate every session at Kirkpatrick Levels 1 and 2 and use the results to improve content and delivery.
Maintain own trainer certification and continuous professional development.
2.4 Manage the Career Development Process for High Potential Employees

Work with the Succession Planning Analyst to design and implement structured career development processes for high potential employees, aligned with Sohar Aluminium's talent management and succession planning objectives.
Manage and optimise the Career Development module in SAP SuccessFactors to ensure effective tracking of career paths, development plans and employee progress.
Collaborate with line managers and Talent Management to identify career aspirations, development needs and potential career opportunities for high-potential employees.
Develop and maintain individual career development plans, outlining target positions, required competencies, development gaps and career progression pathways.
Coordinate targeted development interventions, including job rotations, stretch assignments, coaching, mentoring and formal learning, in line with the 70/20/10 development philosophy.
Monitor the implementation of Individual Development Plans (IDPs), assess progress against agreed milestones and recommend corrective actions where required.
Evaluate the effectiveness of career development initiatives and provide periodic reports and recommendations to management
2.5 Develop and Implement a Professional Accreditation Program (PAP)
Develop and maintain a structured Professional Accreditation Framework aligned with Sohar Aluminium's business needs and competency requirements.
Maintain and optimize the company’s externally accredited Leadership Development Program with the Chartered Management Institute
Collaborate with heads of functions and line managers to identify relevant professional certifications and accreditations for critical roles and specialised functions.
Assess employee eligibility, competency gaps and development needs to determine appropriate professional accreditation pathways.
Coordinate with line managers to prioritise employees for professional accreditation based on business requirements, development needs and approved budgets.
Develop and implement annual professional accreditation plans, including programme selection, timelines, costs and expected outcomes.

Liaise with recognised professional bodies and training providers to facilitate employee enrolment, preparation and certification.Monitor employee progress, examination results and certification completion, ensuring timely follow-up and support.
Maintain accurate records of professional certifications, including validity periods and renewal requirements, where applicable
Evaluate the effectiveness of the Professional Accreditation Program and provide regular progress reports and recommendations for improvement.
2.6 Develop and Implement an English Language Training Program (ELTP)
Consult with Leaders at all levels to confirm the target level of English required for each job group as per the Common European Framework of Referenc
Manage completion of CEFR-based English language tests to identify gaps
Consult with Managers to agree priority for all ELT gaps identified ⠀⠀
2.7 Develop and Implement an e-Learning Program
Work with Superintendent POD and TOE Manager to engage the services of an external e-learning provider
Maximise use of e-learning to satisfy employee training needs as part of a blended learning strategy
Explore utilization of new technologies such as AI and VR to enhance effectiveness of employee learning and development
Ensure all e-learning courses are integrated with the company’s Learning Management System on the SAP SuccessFactors system

d: A leading Kuwait-based regional group is strengthening its leadership team.
We are looking for an experienced corporate and commercial lawyer to lead the Legal function as Legal Manager.

This is the most senior in-house Legal position in the company. You will report into senior management, work directly with the Board when required, and have overall responsibility for the company’s Legal function.
Lead Legal work relating to corporate restructurings, investments, joint ventures, new entities, shareholder matters and other strategic transactions.
Support the Legal workstreams required for IPO readiness and work closely with external Legal and IPO advisers.

Own the drafting, review and negotiation of significant commercial agreements across the Group, including supplier, distribution, technology, services, partnership, logistics and other strategic arrangements.
You should be comfortable handling difficult commercial negotiations and finding solutions that protect the company without unnecessarily slowing the business down.
Advise senior management on Companies Law, corporate structures, authorities, shareholder matters and Board-related Legal issues.
Work closely with the Governance and Compliance functions on matters relevant to IPO and listed-company readiness.
Lead the company’s Legal function and act as the senior internal Legal adviser to management.
Manage external counsel in Kuwait and other GCC markets, oversee significant disputes and litigation, strengthen Legal processes and templates, and provide practical Legal advice across the business.
q: You are likely to have 10+ years of strong corporate and commercial Legal experience, gained in a respected law firm, listed company, major private group or complex operating business.
You should have strong hands-on experience in areas such as
Advising senior management on corporate and commercial Legal matters.
Managing disputes, litigation and external Legal counsel.
Corporate transactions, restructurings, acquisitions or joint ventures.
Providing independent, practical and commercially focused Legal advice.
Strong knowledge of the Kuwait Legal and commercial environment is important.
Professional-level Arabic and English are required, including the ability to review, draft and negotiate Legal documents in both languages.
Experience with listed companies, IPOs, CMA/Boursa Kuwait matters, Board matters or GCC operations is an advantage, but is not mandatory.
Previous responsibility for a Legal team is preferred.

d: Job Type: Full-time, showroom-based (6 days a week on a rota)

Founded in 2013, Oldtimer Motorcycles is an established name in the Middle East's motorcycle community, with operations in Dubai, Saudi Arabia and Qatar – and from December 2026, Kuwait. We specialise in premium motorcycles, parts, riding gear and accessories for every riding discipline – Adventure & Touring, Off-Road / Enduro, Road / Café and Sport Track. We represent more than 120 premium brands and serve riders who care about quality, performance and authenticity.

We are opening our Kuwait showroom in December 2026 and are looking for a Sales Associate to be part of the founding team. You will be the person Kuwaiti riders meet when they walk in: advising them in Arabic and English on gear, helmets, parts and accessories, fitting them properly, and building the customer base that will make Oldtimer the first name in motorcycling in Kuwait. You must ride, or know motorcycles well enough that a rider trusts your advice.
q: Fluent Arabic and good English, spoken and written
Rider, or solid knowledge of motorcycles, riding gear and the local riding scene
2+ years' experience in retail sales, ideally in motorcycle, automotive, sports or outdoor equipment
Confident, friendly and professional with customers
Comfortable using a POS or ERP system
Reliable and punctual, able to work weekends and public holidays on a rota
Able to stand for long periods and handle stock
Based in Kuwait with the right to work there
Knowledge of riding gear brands and helmet safety standards (ECE 22.06, FIM)
Experience with ERPNext or a similar system
r: Welcome customers and advise them on riding gear, helmets, parts and accessories across all riding disciplines
Fit helmets, jackets, boots and protective gear correctly, and explain sizing, safety standards and care
Process sales, returns and exchanges on the POS / ERPNext system accurately
Handle phone, WhatsApp, Instagram and walk-in enquiries in Arabic and English, and follow up on quotations and reserved items
Keep the showroom, displays and fitting areas clean, organised and fully stocked
Receive stock into the showroom, update shelf locations and report low or slow-moving items; take part in stock counts
Help set up the showroom before opening and support launch events and ride-outs
Build relationships with local riding groups, clubs and workshops
Learn our brands and products continuously, and feed Kuwaiti customer preferences back to the buying team in Dubai
